fusions.name: Forked Branch
fusions.desc: Hurls a forked branch that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets. It then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles, the hit dealing 100% of the original damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Crossed Purposes
fusions.desc: Seizes up to 2 enemies within 3.5 tiles and turns them against each other for 5 seconds. Each takes 10 damage and is stunned for 1 second.

fusions.name: Two-Pronged Guard
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and each such blow has a 30% chance to turn the attacker against its allies for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Either Hand
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.
